svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Istio service mesh with sidecars
svg.desc: Istio service mesh with sidecars. 11 components in 8 groups. Connections: Users to Ingress gateway (HTTPS); Ingress gateway to Envoy sidecar; Envoy sidecar to frontend (localhost); Envoy sidecar to Envoy sidecar; Envoy sidecar to Envoy sidecar; Envoy sidecar to cart; Envoy sidecar to checkout; Envoy sidecar to Egress gateway; Egress gateway to Payment provider (HTTPS); Ingress gateway to istiod; istiod to Egress gateway; istiod to Namespace shop.

text.tspan: Inside the mesh every hop runs over mutual TLS between Envoy proxies, from the ingress to the egress gateway; istiod configures them all
